dispatch.budget: Use existing configured limits. Attempt bounds are proposed stop conditions, not new spending or concurrency authority.
dispatch.notification: Do not reset or duplicate previously delivered first-success email automation.

experiments.title: Independent original-emulator caller validation of reproduced helper
experiments.method: Reuse merged #524's two 256-case original-file runs and actual instruction mutation result. Next capture one natural original-emulator caller/return and compare argument, result and executed instruction identities; do not rerun unchanged probe as progress.
experiments.attempt_bound: One natural caller sequence; if hooks unavailable, produce bounded capability gap and continue graphics independently.
experiments.validation: Changed result or bit priority must fail; original kernel/hash mismatch must reject.

experiments.title: RNG state transition and bounded draw at candidate 0x0600A0EC
experiments.method: Recover widths, taps, bound handling and seeding; compare outputs and touched state with natural caller trace.
experiments.attempt_bound: One generator and one caller, not all RNG consumers.
experiments.validation: Wrong tap, signedness and wrap cases must be detected.

experiments.title: One actual archive decompression/load path
experiments.method: Coordinate EXP-SAT-ARCHIVE-002 owner; trace store anchor 0x06033E0C and loader 0x06009470; prove original resident bytes.
experiments.attempt_bound: One reserved base1/normal2 resource; preserve current owner.
experiments.validation: Truncation, invalid references and wrong ring semantics; compare resident original bytes, not only round trip.

experiments.title: Sprite-sort append/traverse/reset candidates
experiments.method: Recover one operation around 0x060AA50C/0x060AA57C and compare an original frame's ordering.
experiments.attempt_bound: One operation and small bucket/node set.
experiments.validation: Reverse equal-key order or omit head reset; prove stale excluded tails are unread.

experiments.title: Score/dino growth update candidate 0x06021604
experiments.method: Recover arithmetic and state effects for natural pickup and threshold crossing.
experiments.attempt_bound: One scoring transition with rider/no-rider and second-player controls.
experiments.validation: Wrong threshold, width or player selection must fail.

experiments.title: Read-only Beetle named save-state adapter
experiments.method: Parse real serialized checkpoint, normalize producer word order and retain coherent VDP1/VDP2 arrays.
experiments.attempt_bound: One accepted real checkpoint and one independent span comparison before extending formats.
experiments.validation: Truncated/duplicate/oversized fields and swapped payload reject or differ; synthetic parser tests do not qualify as game extraction.

experiments.title: One original pattern with verified colour interpretation
experiments.method: Reuse export_vdp1; select actually observed RGB or implement the observed indexed sprite/CRAM mode.
experiments.attempt_bound: One observed command/mode; unsupported modes explicit.
experiments.validation: Palette/nibble/CRAM-offset/type mutations must be detected by applicable comparison.

experiments.title: Actual VDP1 command-flow discovery
experiments.method: Reconstruct next/assign/call/return, skips/end and word-to-byte addressing; compare bounded trace.
experiments.attempt_bound: One original list; finite visit budget and explicit mid-draw phase.
experiments.validation: Cycle, out-of-range link and incorrect return semantics must reject or mismatch.

experiments.title: One newly extracted useful spritesheet
experiments.method: Capture short idle/walk/effect sequence, retain patterns/palettes/anchors and pack deterministic PNG+JSON with concrete private preview.
experiments.attempt_bound: One useful sheet; no complete game atlas or Godot integration prerequisite.
experiments.validation: Fresh-directory regeneration and native/pixel comparison; address-only dedupe and source-orientation mistakes must be detectable.

experiments.title: One VDP2 cell plane patch
experiments.method: Derive actual enabled simple plane format and decode one cell plus small map.
experiments.attempt_bound: One simple mode; explicitly reject unsupported rotation/scroll/bitmap paths.
experiments.validation: Wrong pattern-name entry/palette/flip must be visible in comparison.

experiments.title: Validate original object/map/item layout
experiments.method: Resolve 0x7C stride versus fields crossing record boundary and contradictory bomb/object notes with original writer/allocation evidence.
experiments.validation: Field/stride or item-kind substitutions must fail observations; never write cross-record offsets on comment authority.

experiments.title: Separate frame/poll/stage/timer timebases
experiments.method: Capture load/menu/pause/match/restart counter progress and consuming routines.
experiments.attempt_bound: One short route through named transitions.
experiments.validation: Compare event order plus declared clock; deliberate one-update offset must be detected.

experiments.title: One original CPU decision branch
experiments.method: Locate actual original CPU callback; compare natural behaviour and one-factor forced-state pairs with recorded RNG.
experiments.attempt_bound: One decision branch and controlled map differences.
experiments.validation: Wrong danger/escape condition must fail; forced states are labelled.

experiments.title: Measured item/bomb interaction matrix
experiments.method: Record bounded setup/stimulus/cells/damage/timing; anchor forced setups in naturally reached events.
experiments.attempt_bound: A small named interaction set; unknowns remain unknown.
experiments.validation: Boundary and counterexample cases; distinguish invincible/forced clears from ordinary damage.

experiments.title: Retail TEST OPTION dispatcher
experiments.method: Find retail strings and CFG homologues; prototype flag 0x060C1464 is only a lead, never a retail patch instruction.
experiments.attempt_bound: One dispatcher and one media resource; preserve separate test save/profile.
experiments.validation: Verify supplied build and unmodified guard/flow before patch; menu alone is not recovery.

experiments.title: One sound-driver/sample resource mapping
experiments.method: Verify PROGRAM.BIN driver 0x44+0x63D4, runtime self-patching and one SE event's SCSP sample/pitch/loop.
experiments.attempt_bound: One original sound/sample; no entire archive interpreted as PCM.
experiments.validation: Wrong boundaries/pitch/driver-versus-sample classification must be detected.

experiments.title: Validated Ghidra import and library classification
experiments.method: Load actual kernel/base or verified state format; retain signature/cross-region match confidence and original-byte comparison.
experiments.attempt_bound: One kernel/function slice; Ghidra completion never blocks S01.
experiments.validation: Wrong base/build/function match must fail; classify generic SDK separately from game logic.

experiments.title: Ymir headless capability audit
experiments.method: At inspected pin main only parses config/prints/exits; only adopt a new pin after real emulation, transport and memory-read proof.
experiments.attempt_bound: Stop after capability result; do not spend a full adapter build against a scaffold.
experiments.validation: Successful config parsing is explicitly not BIOS/game/debugger execution.

observed_original_baseline.scope: CPU-only original helper; no independent emulator/caller/timing validation or spritesheet
